correctness.rationale: The original homotopy equivalence is Theorem 3.1 of Babson et al. The stabilizer argument gives simple connectivity by Armstrong. Direct signed Lefschetz traces establish rational acyclicity. The package verifier exhaustively generates 785 labeled faces, 175069 quotient barycentric cells, computes seven exact F2 boundary ranks, checks each differential square, and verifies Betti numbers (1,0,0,0,2,2,0). UCT and rational acyclicity rigorously imply H4[2] is (Z/2)^2 and no other 2-torsion; full primary exponents are not asserted.

value.rationale: The exact two-rank is a natural finite torsion invariant of the five-point non-biconnected graph complex under all pentagon symmetries. It supplies a simply connected, rationally acyclic, noncontractible orbit-space example with two independent 2-torsion classes—information unavailable from the labeled rational character or known free cyclic quotients. No full integral homology or torsion exponents are claimed.
